headline: Committee gives public summary of closed session on case strategy and settlement

meeting.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meeting.summary: The committee met with its attorney in executive session on the county's legal powers and duties, case strategy and settlement efforts. A motion by Member Cook passed 8 ayes, 0 noes, with Member Sugimura excused from the vote.
meeting.recap: Members had just finished an executive session (a closed-door discussion) on Resolution 26-141.[[0:54:52]] The chair asked for a public summary of the closed session, as required under a section of state law.[[0:54:59]] The summary said the committee met with its attorney to discuss the county's powers, duties, privileges, immunities, and liabilities.[[0:55:06]] The closed talk also covered case strategy, including the strengths and weaknesses of the case.[[0:55:17]] It also covered settlement authority and settlement efforts to date.[[0:55:22]] The chair asked if members had more to discuss, and no one did.[[0:55:29]] Member Cook made the motion, and it was seconded.[[0:55:45]] The motion passed with 8 ayes and 0 noes.[[0:55:53]] Member Sugimura was excused from the vote.[[0:56:00]]
